principal of St.

John’s Hall, Highbury

He was author of The Names on the Gates of Pearl.

He married (22 July 1865) Anna Maria Stubbs.

He was tutor and then (1884) principal of St.

John's Hall, Highbury, theological college.

His mother was the niece of Mary Martha Sherwood [ODNB]
